experience.player_does: Launch the game, press Play, and move through the authored cell map at the selected 15-unit presentation scale.
experience.feels_like: The world has enough visible context for navigation while individual compositions remain close to the concept image's visual density. The throwaway scale experiment and its debug controls are not present.
experience.camera: Keep the existing fixed 1920x1080 logical view and top-left map presentation; only the permanent cell pitch changes.
experience.controls: Existing Play and Quit behavior remains unchanged. No scale-cycle or performance debug controls are added in this reimplementation.
experience.not_this: Not a zoom system, persisted user setting, camera redesign, world expansion, or new cell vocabulary.

design_refs.why: The settled presentation must preserve a readable balance between individual cell compositions and navigational context.
The chosen pitch changes presentation density only; the existing cell grammar and authored compositions remain unchanged.

mockup.not_possible: The choice was made from live interaction and a raster concept image; a static vector mockup would not represent the relevant visual density.

considered_existing.why_not: It already owns the exported cell pitch and cell placement, so changing that existing presentation value avoids introducing another renderer or configuration path.
Cell pitch is presentation state and must not enter the typed persisted map boundary.

modules.role: Own the permanent cell presentation pitch in the existing map renderer.
modules.why: The selected scale needs to be reimplemented without restoring the temporary experiment or changing authored map data.
modules.boundary_data: Reads typed LevelFormat and LevelLayer values and emits the existing canvas drawing at the permanent pitch.

files.why: Set the permanent exported cell pitch to 15 logical units while preserving the existing map drawing and menu behavior.
Record the settled fullscreen scale and remove the open scale question from the design narrative.
Append the human's 15-unit decision and close the fullscreen-scale question without rewriting prior ledger entries.
Regenerate the design index after the scale-and-camera section is settled.
